answer.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ. Memory_91 demonstrated that activation messaging inside the product improved week-one engagement and nudged accounts to first meaningful action—directly addressing the activation decline. Memory_86 showed onboarding simplification lifted adoption. These two memories together suggest the onboarding-to-activation funnel is the constraint. Activation messaging is lower-risk than promotional pricing (which memory_73 shows creates unsustainable revenue lift with retention harm) and addresses root cause rather than masking it. Referral incentives work best with established customers (memory_57), but we need to fix early-stage activation first. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) is valuable but doesn't address the SMB activation drop or help against competitive pricing pressure. Verifying memory_31 and memory_91 will confirm the activation messaging effect size and whether simplification+messaging compound. A standard experiment on activation messaging preserves the option to layer in other tactics if needed, stays focused on sustainable qualified revenue (not just volume), and directly targets the observed activation decline without creating the retention risk of deep discounting.
